turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's essay. Why is there a zero on it?
"Upset" isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
But I'm not changing the grade.
"I'm not changing the grade." On what basis, exactly, when you haven't shown me a single thing yet?
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.
"Keep going if you like." You asked for this meeting, Hale, and your own procedure says I get a call before any mark is entered, and nobody called me.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
"The answer is no" is a decision, not a reason. Put the reason on that desk, or I take this to the principal's office today.
